g.text: tm = A U x s, x = max(0, 1 − Σ w_k D_k)

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2d3748

g.text: ΔW = ηLTP (Wmax − W) E trᵀ − ηLTD tr Eᵀ

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #999999

g.text: M_EI and M_IE are fixed: strong on the diagonal,

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #999999

g.text: weak off it. Only W is plastic.

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #2d3748

g.text: Three memories: an unlearned per-channel one,

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #2d3748

g.text: a learned cross-channel one, and a slow

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #2d3748

g.text: inhibitory state that decides how they show.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2d3748

text.style: font-size: 5.9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #999999

g.text: one excitatory and one inhibitory cell per tonotopic channel · trained lateral connections solid, untrained dotted

g.text: rather than a set of tokens.
